Opera is making waves 🎭 Sting and Shaggy at the Met Opera for The Last Ship. @metopera x @theofficialsting x @direalshaggy 🚢❤️

Written and composed by Sting, the musical is inspired by his childhood in the shipbuilding town of Wallsend in England and tells the story of a community fighting to save its shipyard.

For a limited time only, the show runs June 9–14, 2026 at the Met Opera in Lincoln Centre with just nine performances.
